rank.title: Renaissance rank
rank.summary: Earned through completed sessions and active training weeks, never weight moved.
rank.definition: An active week has at least one completed session.
rank.highestBody: Your participation has completed the Renaissance rank path.

comeback.evidence: {inactiveDays} full days away · {activeDays} active days in {windowDays} days
comeback.title: Comeback recognition
comeback.summary: Time away does not erase the work of returning.
comeback.rule: A comeback is recorded after {minimumInactiveDays} full days without a completed workout, then {requiredActiveDays} separate training days within {windowDays} days of returning. Sessions on the same day count once.
comeback.truncated: Shows comebacks detected in your 500 most recent completed sessions.
comeback.emptyBody: If time away happens, returning steadily can earn one. An uninterrupted streak is not the only form of consistency.

milestones.title: Next milestones
milestones.summary: Follow your plan, use appropriate loads, and keep recovery days.
milestones.explanation: One fixed next milestone in each category, with no deadline. Categories stay in a stable order, not ranked by what is closest.
